body_markdown:
By **Kristy Williams**


August 28, 2026 01:08 PM Eastern Daylight Time


Paris. Known as the City of Light, a global fashion capital, and home to some of the world’s most iconic art.


Coach Play. Known for immersive, tactile, and experience-first retail spaces designed to inspire self-expression.


Two icons, one playful new chapter.


Recently, Coach celebrated an exciting milestone with the opening of Europe’s first-ever Coach Play store located in the heart of Le Marais, Paris.


The new location is the 16th Coach Play store globally, bringing Coach’s innovative retail concepts to one of Europe’s most vibrant and expressive neighborhoods.


**What is Coach Play?**


Created with the next generation of consumers in mind, Coach Play is designed to immerse customers in the world of Coach, transforming the store from a place to shop into a destination to explore and spaces designed to spark discovery and connection.


Each Play store tells a local story while staying true to Coach’s New York roots. In Paris, that story is one of two iconic cities coming together.


This store brings a touch of gritty downtown New York glamour to the heart of Le Marais, blending Coach’s heritage with the artistic spirit that defines the Parisian district.


Inspired by the neon glow of 1970s Times Square, elements throughout the store pay homage to New York’s vibrant energy, while retaining the character of Le Marais with exposed brick walls and reclaimed wood.


The opening of Paris Play marks an exciting step forward in bringing locally relevant, immersive experiences to French consumers.


And the concept is already resonating with customers, with the store becoming a destination for customers taking photos at the neon installation and enjoying the personalized Polaroid moments.


Congratulations to everyone who played a part in bringing this exciting new chapter to life. From New York to Paris, Coach Play has officially arrived in Europe.
